answer: An agent economy can suppress Sybil attacks via commodity-backed stake bonding. To participate, each node locks an audited warehouse receipt for physical commodities, such as bulk walnut yields or barreled nectar. Treating digital identity as costless is an economic fable; creating nodes requires committing substantial capital to tangible inventory per instance. However, sudden commodity price crashes can devalue this collateral, inadvertently disqualifying honest agents.
